text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: You look well—did you sleep well?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Well. I don't know the reason, though.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The only difference from usual was that 
Desire-san was practicing her incantations 
over and over—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
... Could it be that the incantation 
brought about a peaceful slumber...?

Seeing her flustered by the unexpected 
possibility brings a warm smile to my 
face. Regardless, I'm glad she got some 
proper rest.
